description: Rewrite satuyangterpenting-week2.html with much longer, more substantive article content. Same expansion approach as FEAT-001 - each post grows from ~20 lines to ~50-60 lines with deeper storytelling and more product information.
steps: Rewrite the ENTIRE file, keeping the same HTML wrapper but completely expanding content inside each of the 21 textarea elements

Each article must follow the expanded structure: (1) Bold emotional hook (2-3 sentences), (2) Relatable personal story/scenario (3-4 sentences), (3) Problem with stats using highlight/underline (2 paragraphs), (4) Reflective questions (2-3), (5) Famous quote blockquote, (6) DETAILED product benefits (2-3 paragraphs), (7) Real-life scenario (1 paragraph), (8) Image placeholder, (9) Emotional closing with urgency, (10) 4 CTA buttons

Week 2 themes: Day 1 - Risiko Keuangan (MiUltimate HealthCare), Day 2 - Pencari Nafkah Tiada (MiWealth Protection), Day 3 - Biaya RS Naik (MiUltimate HealthCare Plus), Day 4 - Warisan (MiWealth Legacy), Day 5 - Kecelakaan (MiAccident Guard), Day 6 - Kebebasan Finansial Agen (recruitment), Day 7 - Perencanaan Keuangan Holistik (MiWealth Protection + MiRetirement)
Use different quotes from week 1 - draw from: Tony Robbins, Jim Rohn, Napoleon Hill, Zig Ziglar, Jack Ma, Richard Branson, Mark Twain, etc.
All content in Bahasa Indonesia sopan - no gue/gua/elo/elu

CTA buttons: WhatsApp (https://wa.me/+6287781896087), Info Produk (https://pastijaga.petrusjakub.workers.dev/), Peluang Karir Agen (https://pastijaga.petrusjakub.workers.dev/pages/bisnis), Follow @petrusjakub (https://instagram.com/petrusjakub)

Each textarea content is at least 50 lines long
All posts contain: bold, italic, underline, highlight, blockquote, image, 4 CTA buttons
All 4 CTA button URLs correct in every post
Content themes differ from week 1 in angles and stories
